items.title: Bank Reconciliation / Rekonsiliasi bank
items.description: Match bank statement lines (AI PDF or manual) to SAP GL for a Giro and month. Set opening/closing balances; reconcile when adjusted bank equals adjusted book. Workflow: Create → Save balances → Auto-match / manual match → Submit for validation → Validate → Report / Export Excel.

items.title: Bank Reconciliation — Create / Buat rekonsiliasi
items.description: Start a session in AI mode (parse Koran PDF + fetch SAP) or Manual mode (type bank lines + fetch SAP). Select Giro, period, and Koran PDF for AI.

items.title: Bank Reconciliation — Pending validation
items.description: Validator queue for sessions submitted with Submit for validation. Validators are notified on submit. Open a session and use Validate or Reject (preparer notified on reject).

items.title: Bank Reconciliation — Report and Excel export
items.description: Formal reconciliation statement (adjusted bank vs book, reconciling items). Print from Report, or use Export Excel for a downloadable workbook.

items.title: Rekening Koran / Bank statement dashboard
items.description: Grid dashboard: one cell per account and month. Click empty cell to upload PDF; click filled cell for PDF, reconciliation status, and delete (with delete_koran).

items.title: Help panel / Bantuan aplikasi
items.description: Click the ? icon in the top bar. Ask how-to questions in the How-to tab. Answers come from docs/manuals indexed by php artisan help:reindex.

items.title: Manual Journal Entry / Jurnal umum manual
items.description: List and create manual journal entries (JE-000001 format). Balanced debit/credit lines, optional load from JE Template, Save Journal Entry, then Submit to SAP B1 from show page. Print voucher available.

items.title: Manual Journal Entry — Create
items.menu_path: Accounting → Journal Entries → New Journal Entry
items.description: Form: Date, Reference, Memo, Load from Template dropdown, dynamic Journal Lines grid (account autocomplete, Dr/Cr, amount, project, cost center). Totals must balance before Save Journal Entry.

items.title: JE Templates / Template jurnal
items.description: Shared templates for recurring journal layouts. New Template: name, description, line grid with optional default amounts. Use Load from Template when creating a JE.

items.title: Manual Journal Entry — Reverse in SAP B1
items.menu_path: Accounting → Journal Entries → (open posted JE) → Reverse in SAP B1
items.description: On a posted manual JE show page, users with cancel_sap_journal can reverse the SAP journal with a required reason.

items.title: SAP Sync / Verification Journal validation
items.description: Post realization and bank verification journals to SAP B1. Each VJ must be Validated before Submit to SAP B1. Validators use Validate or Reject on the SAP Sync show page (permission validate_vj). Project tabs show Pending / Validated / Rejected badges.

items.title: SAP Sync — Validate or reject a journal
items.menu_path: Accounting → SAP Sync → (project tab) → open journal
items.description: On the SAP Sync show page, users with validate_vj see Validate and Reject while status is Pending. Reject requires Reason for rejection. After Validated, Submit to SAP B1 is enabled for users with submit permission.

items.title: Dashboard — VJ pending validation
items.description: Validators with validate_vj see a VJ pending validation counter on the dashboard (Action Center when count > 0). Count includes only Pending journals; Rejected journals are excluded until the creator saves a fix. Links to Accounting → SAP Sync.

items.title: Rejected VJ — creator banner and fix
items.description: Creators see a red Verification Journal(s) Rejected banner with reason and Review & Fix. Bank VJs open Bank Transaction edit; others open Edit Details. Saving corrections resets status to Pending (no separate resubmit button). Update SAP and Cancel SAP are disabled while Rejected.

items.title: Bilyet administration (Administrasi Bilyet) / Administrasi Bilyet
items.description: Register and manage Bilyet Giro / Cheque / LOA: New Bilyet (+ Bilyet, permission add_bilyet), bulk Excel import via Upload (template, staging table, Import with Receive Date), release/cair/void actions, filters on the List tab, Audit Trail, History, and Reports. Statuses: onhand, release, cair, void.

items.title: BAPSB — Bank securities inspection report (Berita Acara Pemeriksaan Surat Berharga Bank)
keywords: berita acara pemeriksaan surat berharga bank
items.description: Monthly BAPSB per project for giro accounts flagged needs_bilyet: bilyet list is pulled automatically (status onhand/release, bilyet_date <= period end, cair_date empty or after period end, grouped per bank account). Per line: Present/Missing, location (Brankas Site, Lemari Besi Accounting HO, Brankas BO, Safe Deposit Box Bank, Lainnya), notes and remarks. Auto number BAPSB-0001/{project}/{MM-YYYY}. Print with signature blocks (Prepared by / Checked by 1 / Checked by 2 / Approved by), upload signed PDF (type bapsb, max 5 MB), then Submit for validation.

items.title: BAPSB — HO validation and outstanding list
items.menu_path: Cashier → BAPSB (outstanding) / Dashboard card 'BAPSB pending validation'
items.description: Harus ada permission validate_bapsb_report: kartu 'Late submissions by unit' (project, period, deadline; 12 bulan terakhir sampai bulan berjalan) dan kartu 'Pending HO validation' (number, project, submitted). Validasi dari halaman detail: catatan opsional lalu Validate BAPSB → status validated. Tidak ada tombol reject.

items.title: Bank Transaction — Cheque / Bilyet reference
items.description: Field Cheque / Bilyet (opsional) hanya memuat bilyet dari Bank Account yang dipilih (bilyets.giro_id → giros.id, giros.sap_account). Kosong bila bilyet belum terdaftar untuk rekening itu atau kolom sap_account giro belum diisi. Field ini hanya rujukan aplikasi: tidak dikirim ke SAP dan tidak mengubah status bilyet.
